verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents a Cloudflare edge SDK that evaluates all flags at the edge for a given context, and says it ships 4 edge SDKs. It also offers the Relay Proxy, a self-hosted layer that proxies the streaming connection to clients, which community engineers recommend for running closer to services. Missing for 10: the other three edge platforms are not named in the evidence, and there is no independent hands-on corroboration of edge-worker evaluation (community corroboration covers only the Relay Proxy).

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can evaluate flags at the edge (CDN workers or an edge/relay layer) close to users

citations.quote: The Cloudflare SDK gets all flags at the edge for a given context, and bootstraps them onto a cached payload
30 idiomatic SDKs 13 client-side, 13 server-side, and 4 edge SDKs.
a small Go application that runs on your own infrastructure. It connects to the LaunchDarkly streaming API and proxies that connection to clients
